system.description:
• Effect: Once per month, perform a day-long ritual combining Distort Reality, Hallucinatory Terrain, Permanent Image, Polymorph Any Object, and Spectral Force to create any single object, being, or 10ft×10ft/level area.
  • Beings created can be of Level up to half the illusionist's level with all appropriate creature powers
  • The effect cannot be dispelled for 1 day per caster level (except by a spellcaster of equal or greater level)
  • There is a 1% chance per illusionist level that the creation becomes permanently real — at which point it cannot be dispelled or disbelieved, ever
  • Only one Magnum Opus can exist at a time (unless it has become real)

activities.name: Magnum Opus
activities.text: Perform a day-long ritual to create any single object, being or area, with a 1% chance per level that it becomes permanently real.
